title: Past Project Showcase
text:
LitQuest is an interactive web and mobile application designed to address adult literacy challenges by making classic literature into visual novels. It was created within 24 hours during SparkHacks 2026 with a team of 5.


- Web development and Application Prototype
- Teamwork and collaboration with a team of 5
- Designing technology for social impact and accessibility
- ReactJS, JavaScript, Figma, MongoDB

title: Alex Medina
text: Alexandra Medina is a third year student at the University of Illinois at Chicago studying Computer Science & Applied Statistics, where she also works as a Computer Specialist for the Technology Solutions department. She recently finished an internship as a Quantum AI/ML Intern at Argonne National Laboratory. Alex actively applies her skills to build cybersecurity challenges for UIC’s Capture the Flame, their annual Capture the Flag event.
